label: SAMPLE eval: the 12 sample asks × the 3 presets. Expected verdicts are the hand-written literal reading in lib/sample, the same reading the gate rubric was written next to, so this set is not held out.
author: Alan Arguello
author_note: (hand-written SAMPLE expectations, ported from the prototype’s data.js)

cases.rules:
Happy to talk to founders about Postgres, queues or LLM evals in production.
Only if they have a real workload: a table size, a p95 or an error rate.
No fundraising asks.
No asks to review a deck.

ask.text: Our Postgres p95 went from 40 ms to 900 ms once the events table passed 40M rows. Tried monthly partitions and a read replica; writes still block. Need 20 minutes with someone who has run Postgres past 100M rows, before Nov 21. Offer: our load-test harness.

parts.challenge: Postgres p95 went from 40 ms to 900 ms past 40M rows

parts.needs: Someone who has run Postgres past 100M rows
